evidence_gaps: No fresh-within-2h runtime forensics; evidence.json reports MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS.
No reconciled per-trade wallet deltas covering gas/priority fees, slippage, impact, profit share, fee-transfer gas and failed-transaction gas.
No current Solana size-matched entry/exit quote, liquidity, sellability, priority-fee, rent and latency dataset.
No EVM quote-to-fill decay and predicted-versus-realised calibration by chain, route and notional.
No complete taxonomy and counts separating STRATEGY/MARKET losses from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures.
No out-of-sample sample sizes, regime coverage, drawdown, concentration, tail-loss or lower-confidence-bound statistics.
No evidence that strategy_canary.record_canary_result is wired to receipt-confirmed, fully costed production outcomes.

Before any promotion: require fresh runtime evidence, complete reconciliation, positive money-weighted NET P&L after all costs, profit factor and drawdown bounds, failure-rate bounds, chain-specific regime coverage, out-of-sample validation and exact-source human approval.

proposals.downside_risk: Evidence will arrive later and some trades will remain unresolved until receipts, balances and fee settlements reconcile.

evidence.detail: BROADCAST is treated as executed, and missing realised_net_base falls back to expected_net_base.
Leader-copy scoring consumes realised_net_native rather than realised_user_net_native, so profit share can be omitted from the measured result.
Receipt-confirmed EVM realised_net_base deducts actual cycle gas, but profit-share amount and its settlement gas are recorded separately.

proposals.expected_effect: More conservative and auditable strategy rankings based only on reconciled economic outcomes, with explicit STRATEGY/MARKET versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE attribution.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 reconciled round trips per chain and strategy across 30 days, with 100% cost-field completeness, zero unresolved records included in P&L, and separately reported failure rates.
proposals.rationale: Promotion evidence must represent wallet-level, money-weighted net returns after every execution and service cost. Expected outcomes and pre-fee results can inflate profit factor and misclassify operational failures as neutral trades.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay immutable execution records into a SHADOW ledger. Accept P&L only after confirmed receipt and balance reconciliation; deduct gas, priority fees, slippage/impact, profit share and fee-transfer gas. Mark adverse reconciled returns as STRATEGY_MARKET_LOSS and reverts/timeouts/RPC/nonce/reconciliation faults as EXECUTION_INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE. Stop if any expected-only or BROADCAST-only row affects net P&L or promotion metrics.
proposals.strategy: Strategy Lab realised NET P&L accounting

proposals.downside_risk: Stricter evidence may produce few eligible observations during illiquid or congested periods.

evidence.detail: Solana observations deliberately set edge, liquidity, sellability and costs to zero and declare that a current quote adapter is missing.
The scorecard records solana_current_quote_edge_adapter as an evidence gap and prohibits promotion from quote simulations.
SHADOW P&L uses fixed estimated entry and exit fees, which cannot demonstrate economics under variable priority fees, price impact or route failure.

proposals.expected_effect: Falsifiable Solana SHADOW evidence without inventing profitability, while preserving fail-closed entry, simulation, liquidity and sellability protections.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 200 independent opportunities, 100 complete simulated round trips, 30 trading days, multiple congestion and liquidity regimes, and separate market-loss and infrastructure-failure distributions.
proposals.rationale: Solana economics require contemporaneous executable buy and sell quotes, size-dependent impact, priority/base fees, token-account or refundable-rent treatment, latency and sellability. Historical leader win ratios are not current executable edge.
proposals.shadow_test: For each timestamped leader BUY, capture size-matched entry and immediate sell quotes, route, impact, slippage, priority/base fees, rent treatment and quote age; then mark forward exits using only information available at the decision time. Stop the hypothesis if any missing sell quote passes eligibility, if cost completeness is below 99%, or if reconciled net after costs is non-positive.
proposals.strategy: Solana leader-copy and common Strategy Lab signals

proposals.downside_risk: Longer observation delays promotion and may reject marginal routes that occasionally succeed.

evidence.detail: Eligibility requires positive net edge, liquidity, sellability and fresh quotes.
Net edge deducts gas/builder cost, slippage reserve, price impact and latency reserve when supplied.
Executable quote simulations are explicitly not realised P&L or promotion evidence.
Lifecycle thresholds can advance after only 3 then 8 realised trades, while repository search shows no production caller of record_canary_result.

proposals.expected_effect: Calibrated edge haircuts and chain-specific gas/latency thresholds based on realised quote decay rather than raw positive quote counts.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 300 eligible observations and 100 complete out-of-sample round trips per EVM chain over 30 days, with no single route contributing over 20% of total notional or net profit.
proposals.rationale: The architecture has appropriate pre-trade gates, but durable edge requires out-of-sample quote-to-fill calibration and enough observations to estimate tail losses and failure costs. Tiny samples and an apparently disconnected result recorder cannot establish promotion readiness.
proposals.shadow_test: Pair every eligible quote with a non-broadcast, timestamp-matched re-quote and hypothetical receipt outcome; include LP fees embedded in route output, actual-like gas/priority bids, impact, slippage, latency decay and failure gas. Compare predicted versus observed net by chain and size. Stop if the lower confidence bound of money-weighted net is non-positive, reconciliation coverage is below 99%, or execution/infrastructure failures erase the edge.
proposals.strategy: EVM cross-venue arbitrage and learned-route signals

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote a strategy because quote simulations or historical leader win rate are positive.
rejected_ideas.reason: Neither is realised, out-of-sample, money-weighted NET P&L after all costs and failures.

rejected_ideas.idea: Lower edge, sellability, liquidity, simulation or circuit-breaker thresholds to generate more trades.
rejected_ideas.reason: Trade frequency and win count are not objectives, and weaker protection can convert marginal signals into unrecoverable losses.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat receipt timeouts, reverts or RPC failures as ordinary strategy losses.
rejected_ideas.reason: They are EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures and require separate denominators and remediation from STRATEGY/MARKET losses.
The repository correctly keeps non-atomic cross-DEX candidates SHADOW-only; leg risk can destroy the quoted edge.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The common signal layer correctly requires positive cost-adjusted edge and fails closed on missing Solana executable evidence. However, Strategy Lab can overstate money-weighted NET P&L by accepting BROADCAST/expected EVM results and by recording leader-copy profit before user profit-share costs. Runtime forensics are unavailable, so no strategy is shown profitable, CANARY-ready or LIVE-ready. Loss attribution must separately classify adverse post-entry price movement as STRATEGY/MARKET loss and reverts, timeouts, RPC faults, stale quotes, nonce faults, reconciliation gaps and fee-settlement failures as EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure.
